changelog.headline: Model knowledge base initialized — 41 parameters tested
changes: ADDED coach-change-resets-offense (offense carryover 0.52→0.10 on a new coach, p<.05)
ADDED goal-line carry share → rush TD (r=0.85, best rush-TD signal found)
ADDED red-zone target index → rec TD (r=0.77) + RZ-specialist detection
ADDED coach PROE pass tendency (in-season 0.59; inverts −0.67 on coach change)
ADDED two-year preseason prior (season S-2 significant, p=.027)
ADDED prop trust-band (huge model-vs-line gaps → REVIEW, not fired)
RULED OUT QB-continuity (null, p=.87), WR-defense matchup (noise r=.08), 2-WR SGP correlation (~0)
RULED OUT road-dog edge (decayed 53.8%→~50% since 2023 — market adjusted) and 16 Graveyard angles
MONITOR referee crew (real but weak — 4% of penalty variance; ruled out for totals)
weekly cycle now also tests WEIGHTS + cross-correlation vs the existing model, not just isolated significance

prop_picks.name: AJ Barner
prop_picks.reason: This is a number and a price play: AJ Barner's 2.5 is a hair soft and we're buying the under while it's there. Fair on the under after stripping the 6% juice is 43%; we make it 56% — a +13-point edge, +22% on the ticket at +115. This is a stable, multi-year role, which is exactly where our projections grade out calibrated.

prop_review.name: Jadarian Price
prop_review.reason: We've got Jadarian Price projected well off the 51.5 rushing yards number, which usually means the room repriced his role before we did — a committee, a target-share squeeze, or a snap change. We're flagging it, not firing it, until the depth chart and beat reports confirm the workload.
